policies.title: Unlisted ordinary passports: Paraguay advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Paraguay MFA's current closed no-visa list expressly requires a visa for an unlisted country; its ordinary visitor procedure is reviewed and completed through a Paraguayan consular office before travel.
conditions: Each listed passport is absent from the MFA's current closed no-visa list; no status is derived from a migration-table omission or another nationality.

The standard tourist route requires digital filing, consular review and a consular interview; after approval, the visa is collected at a Paraguayan embassy or consulate before travel, so it is an advance visa rather than an eVisa.
MFA's separate exceptional arrival process requires a justified case, an inviter and prior Ministry approval. It is not an unconditional nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route.
Work, residence, study, transit, special passports, qualifying third-country documents and final admission are excluded.

conflicts.explanation: The MFA's closed no-visa list omits Mongolia and expressly requires a visa for an unlisted country, while the National Migration Directorate's live schedule gives Mongolia a 30-day tourist waiver. The directly conflicting current authorities do not establish one baseline.

unresolved.reason: The National Migration Directorate's live schedule directly grants Mongolia a 30-day tourist waiver, while the MFA's closed no-visa list omits Mongolia and says an unlisted country requires a visa. The official conflict is not normalized.
